{"id": "138:5", "words": "pusestes sobre mim a vossa mão", "readings": ["you laid your hand on me in protection or blessing", "you seized me / laid your hand on me in constraint or chastisement"], "likelyHeard": "protection or blessing"},

{"id": "138:11", "words": "as trevas me calquem aos pés", "readings": ["the darkness will crush / trample me underfoot", "the darkness will cover me over"], "likelyHeard": "darkness will trample or overwhelm me, if 'calquem' is understood at all"},
{"id": "138:11", "words": "e a noite será a minha luz nas minhas delícias", "readings": ["still part of what I said: even the night would be light around me in my pleasures", "the answer: even so, the night becomes light for me, to my delight", "'delícias' as sinful pleasures in which night conceals me"], "likelyHeard": "obscure; probably that the night will become light and a joy for me, without knowing whether this is still the speaker's fear or the reply"},
{"id": "138:12", "words": "as trevas não se escurecerão para vós", "readings": ["darkness is not dark to you (you see through it)", "darkness will not grow dark on your account / you will not darken"], "likelyHeard": "darkness is not dark for God"},
